pattern.summary: Bash commands fail with "No such file or directory" on paths the agent assumed existed

evidence.excerpt:
cd packages/api && npm test
bash: cd: packages/api: No such file or directory

rule.title: Verify paths before cd
rule.snippet: Before `cd <dir>`, run `ls <dir>` to confirm the directory exists.
rule.rationale: Agent repeatedly assumes directory layout, causing ENOENT retry loops.
